process_steps.method: integrated extrusion and equal-channel angular pressing (IEECAP)

parameters.cooling_method: quenched in water at room temperature
parameters.deformation: extruded to 10 mm × 10 mm bar, channel angle 90°

evidence.quote: The homogenized billets and the IEECAP die were pre-heated for 1 h at 400 ◦C. Afterward, the billets were extruded at 400 ◦C into bars with a sectional dimension of 10 mm × 10 mm. The angle between the equal channels is 90 ◦ to obtain a high strain level. The plunger speed was approximately 3 mm/s. All extruded bars were quenched in water at room temperature immediately after extrusion.
